# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **GLES and HarfBuzz updates**

## Highlights

The 4.155 development line modernizes GLES interop signatures and updates bundled HarfBuzz. The renderer-facing interop surface now uses pointer-based signatures, and HarfBuzz advances to version 14.4.0.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **Pointer-based GLES interop signatures** — Updates the GLES interop declarations to use pointer-based signatures for native graphics integrations. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.4.0** — Refreshes the bundled text-shaping engine to HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))
